  • Constructor Details

    • Lobby

      public Lobby(GameModelInterface model, Player creator, Level level, int numPlayers, Consumer<Lobby> removeLobby)
      Creates a new Lobby instance.
      Parameters:
      model - the game model interface to use for creating the game
      creator - the player who created the lobby
      level - the level of the game
      numPlayers - the number of players allowed in the lobby
      removeLobby - the method to call when the lobby is removed

    • Lobby

      public Lobby(boolean demoMode, boolean editScenario, GameModelInterface model, Player creator, Level level, int numPlayers, Consumer<Lobby> removeLobby)
      Creates a new Lobby instance with additional parameters for demo mode and scenario editing.
      Parameters:
      demoMode - true if the lobby should skip building and load a demo scenario, false otherwise
      editScenario - true if the lobby should edit the scenario by saving ships to a file at the end of the building phase, false otherwise
      model - the game model interface to use for creating the game
      creator - the player who created the lobby
      level - the level of the game
      numPlayers - the number of players allowed in the lobby
      removeLobby - the method to call when the lobby is removed

    • addPlayer

      public boolean addPlayer(Player player)
      Adds a player to the lobby, assigning a color among the remaining ones. If numPlayers is not reached, enqueues the joining event, otherwise starts the game. If the lobby is in demo mode it skips building.
      Parameters:
      player - the player to add

    • notifyPlayerDisconnection

      public void notifyPlayerDisconnection(Player player)
      Notifies the lobby and its players that a player has disconnected. If all players have disconnected it schedules the removal of the lobby
      Parameters:
      player - the player who has disconnected

    • notifyPlayerReconnection

      public void notifyPlayerReconnection(Player player)
      Notifies the lobby and its players that a player has reconnected. Cancels the scheduled removal of the lobby if necessary.
      Parameters:
      player - the player who has reconnected

    • notifyPlayerExit

      public void notifyPlayerExit(Player player)
      Notifies the lobby and its players that a player has exited the lobby.
      Parameters:
      player - the player who has exited
